services.name: Tour Times
services.desc: Group visits include an introduction presentation given by a Museum Docent, followed by a 15-minute video on the collection. You can preview the film by clicking here. Gallery tours, special programs or specific topic tours must be arranged prior to your visit and include additional fees. Tours are offered to groups Tuesday through Saturday. The first tour starts at 10:00 a.m. The last tour starts at 3:30 p.m.* Total visiting time for group tours is one and a half hours not to exceed two hours.
